$description: Closed asset-role vocabulary for every media field in the PageSpec schema. Derived by reading the real usage sites in src/ and the contracts in sections/. The source is a REAL, live company (Lightdash): real customer and partner trademarks, real named employees / speakers / authors, real compliance marks, a real Cal.com booking calendar, real forms, a real YouTube video and real blog / story content.

generationPolicies.may-generate-new: Abstract decoration with no real referent; new generation allowed within tokens.
generationPolicies.must-reuse-exact: Brand-owned library asset; reuse the exact approved file, never regenerate or alter.
generationPolicies.must-not-fabricate: Real third-party trademark or personal-identity / proprietary editorial asset; never generate, alter or reproduce from memory. Only a human-supplied licensed reference, else a neutral placeholder.
generationPolicies.must-not-reuse-live-endpoint: Never bind to a live third-party endpoint / id / host from the source site; leave an assetRef slot for a human to fill.

pinNote: Every role is pinned to one specific policy, not merely to membership in the 4-value set: verify_all.py fails if any role is changed to a different valid value (proven by prove_drift.sh pinned_asset_role_changed).

forbiddenLiveHostPatterns.why: live job board (the careers button targets jobs.ashbyhq.com/lightdash)

forbiddenLiveHostNote: semantic_validate.py rejects any PageSpec string value matching these case-insensitive patterns (rule NO_LIVE_ENDPOINT). Brand-owned product hosts (app.lightdash.cloud, demo.lightdash.com, docs.lightdash.com, changelog.lightdash.com, github.com/lightdash) are allowed as open-external targets.

licensing.repoVisibility: PRIVATE. Do NOT make this repository or design-repo.zip public. It cites a real company's real customers, employees, quotes, logos, compliance marks, roadmap and live endpoints.
licensing.fonts: Britti Sans Trial (Regular/Medium/Semibold/Bold) are TRIAL-licence fonts downloaded from the live site (src/index.css font-face names "Britti Sans Trial ..."); Pixelify Sans, Fragment Mono, Geist and Inter are open fonts. A licence is required before redistributing or using Britti commercially.
licensing.cloneCopyNote: Article, story, event and legal bodies in the clone are placeholder text (specs/cms-templates.md line 9, src/components/legal/placeholder.js): the real long-form copy is deliberately absent. Product-page, pricing and company-page copy IS real marketing copy and quotes of the real company.
licensing.thirdPartyScripts: Intercom, Clarity, RudderStack, Warmly, HubSpot and the Framer editor bar are NOT part of the design (CLONE_SPEC.md line 28 in section 0, and section 9; specs/SHARED.md line 352). Intercom, Clarity, RudderStack and Warmly appear in the saved original HTML; none of them is in the clone (index.html loads only /src/main.jsx): never recreate them. HubSpot is referenced only in specs/comments (the footer newsletter and forms are UI-only).

animation.rive.guidance: Brand-owned Rive files (nav wordmark, embedding hero, startups dashboard). Reuse the exact .riv; do not author new state machines.

badge.compliance.guidance: Real compliance / award marks of a real company (AICPA SOC2, GDPR, SOC2/HIPAA rings, 8 G2 badges in the footer). Never generate a badge or imply a certification the new site does not hold.

decor.pixel-tile.guidance: Decorative pixel tiles, corners, bands (hero clusters, plan-card corners, post pixels, graphic border). Pure decoration without a real referent: new generation allowed within the palette.

decor.sticker.guidance: The six About-page stickers (abstract brand doodles, draggable). New stickers may be generated; they carry no real person or trademark.

embed.booking-cal.guidance: The Cal.com booking embed (lightdash.cal.com/lightdash/talk, namespace talk-modal / start-talk, embed.js from app.cal.com). A LIVE third-party endpoint: a generated PageSpec carries an assetRef slot only; never the host, handle or embed URL.

embed.live-demo.guidance: The /data-apps hero iframe pointing at forecast-slider.vercel.app (a third-party deployment). Never reuse the URL; leave an assetRef slot.

embed.youtube.guidance: The /beyond-copilots YouTube replay (video id S9NJrqRYRhs, real speakers) and its poster. Never reuse the video id, embed URL or live URL.

form.submission-endpoint.guidance: Where a form posts. The clone submits nothing (PartnerForm / PadelApply preventDefault; Footer newsletter UI-only) but the live forms post to real backends (HubSpot / Framer form backend) that were not inspected. Never bind a real form id/endpoint; leave a slot.

icon.pixel-art.guidance: Abstract 16-84px pixel-art icons with no real referent (benefit icons, roadmap column icons, face icons, event detail icons). New icons may be generated within the pixel style and token colours.

illustration.hero-diagram.guidance: Brand-owned hero SVG / PNG diagrams (e.g. conversational-analytics heroimage SVG, fintech benefit illustrations, split-row images). Reuse the exact file.

illustration.html-diagram.guidance: The /context-layer HTML context diagram (src/components/pages/context-layer/context-diagram.html, 1200 lines, own prefers-reduced-motion rules). Brand-owned: reuse exactly.

image.cms-cover.guidance: Real blog thumbnails, story banners/logos and YouTube poster images produced by the company (public/assets/cms, ~129 files). Proprietary editorial imagery: do not regenerate or imitate; supply licensed images or placeholders.

logo.customer-partner.guidance: Real customer, partner and co-host trademarks (nav customer cells, 6-logo rows, pricing / playground grids, fintech strip, partner strip, security tiles, event co-hosts). Never generate, redraw, recolour, reorder to imply endorsement or reproduce from memory. Only a human-supplied licensed asset may fill the slot, otherwise a neutral placeholder. Identify logos by alt text: several source file names do not match the logo they contain (public/assets/pages/fintech/hypebeast-*.png renders Wise, kraken-*.png renders Titanbay; pricing.jsx maps the "octopus energy" alt to alma-*.svg).

logo.integration.guidance: Real third-party tool trademarks on the integrations directory (Amazon Athena, BigQuery, dbt, GitHub ...). Never redraw or invent integrations that Lightdash does not offer.

photo.person-avatar.guidance: Photos of real named customers, partners, speakers and blog authors (quote avatars, partner carousel portraits, speaker photos, post author avatars). Never generate a face or reuse a real person's likeness; use a human-supplied licensed photo or a neutral silhouette placeholder.

photo.team-member.guidance: Portraits (static + hover variant) of real employees on /about. Never generate or reuse.

screenshot.product-ui.guidance: Real Lightdash product UI screenshots (accordion / tab / card images, hero visuals). Brand-owned: reuse the exact approved file; never fabricate a fake Lightdash screen or restyle one.

video.self-hosted.guidance: The brand-owned self-hosted /bi-as-code product video. Reuse the exact file; do not generate a stand-in video.

app.iframe-bundle.guidance: The Three.js Game Boy app bundle under public/gameboy/ (3.4 MB: index.html, GLB model, textures, sounds, vendor scripts, people/logo images of real customers). Not referenced by any PageSpec field (the homepage is an opaque iframe); documented so it is never regenerated. Its internal customer logos / people images fall under logo.customer-partner / photo.person-avatar rules.
